# The config's reachability entries are the only source of a VEX status.
# CVE-2024-1111, declared not reachable by its id, is published not_affected,
# code_not_reachable, with a detail citing the entry, and keeps its rating;
# CVE-2024-2222, found on curl and libcurl4, is not covered by an entry on
# curl alone; CVE-2024-3333, on which nothing is declared, publishes nothing.
exec vens generate --llm=mock --debug-dir=dbg --config-file=declared.yaml --sbom-serial-number=urn:uuid:3e671687-395b-41f5-a30f-a58921a69b79 report.json declared.cdx.json
stderr 'level=INFO msg="Declared not reachable; the VEX publishes it not_affected, code_not_reachable, with its rating" vuln=CVE-2024-1111'
! stderr 'Declared not reachable;.* vuln=CVE-2024-2222'
json-contains declared.cdx.json '"state": "not_affected"'
json-contains declared.cdx.json '"justification": "code_not_reachable"'
json-contains declared.cdx.json '"detail": "Declared not reachable by config.yaml reachability[0] (cve: CVE-2024-1111). Provenance: call graph review, no path from the HTTP handlers"'
exec sh -c 'grep -c "\"state\": \"not_affected\"" declared.cdx.json'
stdout '^1$'
vex-vectors declared.cdx.json 3
exec sh -c 'cat dbg/run-*/answers.json'
stdout '"unreachable": \['

# The same answers without the entries rate every CVE alike: the status
# moves no level.
exec vens generate --llm=mock --config-file=silent.yaml --sbom-serial-number=urn:uuid:3e671687-395b-41f5-a30f-a58921a69b79 report.json silent.cdx.json
! json-contains silent.cdx.json 'not_affected'
exec sh -c 'grep "\"vector\"" declared.cdx.json > declared.vectors; grep "\"vector\"" silent.cdx.json > silent.vectors'
cmp declared.vectors silent.vectors

# An entry declaring the CVE reachable, here by one of its packages, vetoes
# the status: none is published, and vens warns.
exec vens generate --llm=mock --config-file=vetoed.yaml --sbom-serial-number=urn:uuid:3e671687-395b-41f5-a30f-a58921a69b79 report.json vetoed.cdx.json
stderr 'level=WARN msg="Reachability entries disagree; one asserting reachability vetoes the status, so none is published" vuln=CVE-2024-1111'
! json-contains vetoed.cdx.json 'not_affected'

# An entry with two selectors is refused at load, before any call.
! exec vens generate --llm=mock --config-file=refused.yaml --sbom-serial-number=urn:uuid:3e671687-395b-41f5-a30f-a58921a69b79 report.json refused.cdx.json
stderr 'reachability\[0\] gives both cve and component: an entry has one selector'
! exists refused.cdx.json

-- declared.yaml --
schema_version: 2
project:
  name: "reachability-test"
context:
  exposure: "internet"
  data_sensitivity: "high"
  business_criticality: "critical"
reachability:
  - cve: CVE-2024-1111
    reachable: false
    provenance: "call graph review, no path from the HTTP handlers"
  - component: curl
    reachable: false
    provenance: "the binary is never invoked"
-- silent.yaml --
schema_version: 2
project:
  name: "reachability-test"
context:
  exposure: "internet"
  data_sensitivity: "high"
  business_criticality: "critical"
-- vetoed.yaml --
schema_version: 2
project:
  name: "reachability-test"
context:
  exposure: "internet"
  data_sensitivity: "high"
  business_criticality: "critical"
reachability:
  - cve: CVE-2024-1111
    reachable: false
    provenance: "call graph review, no path from the HTTP handlers"
  - component: OpenSSL
    reachable: true
    provenance: "a fuzzing harness reached it"
-- refused.yaml --
schema_version: 2
project:
  name: "reachability-test"
context:
  exposure: "internet"
  data_sensitivity: "high"
  business_criticality: "critical"
reachability:
  - cve: CVE-2024-1111
    component: openssl
    reachable: false
    provenance: "review"
